# Gate review template

Instructional template only. It contains no approval. The canonical result belongs in the delivery register; sensitive review material belongs in its approved evidence system.

Record gate/campaign IDs, release/source/artifact revisions, environment/scope, review date, reviewer identity and authority, and any participation/independence requirements.

| Criterion | Expected outcome | Evidence ID / level | Observed result and limitation | Reviewer assessment |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Use an actual GNN.NN ID | Link its canonical criterion | Reference an immutable verified artifact | Report actual pass/failure/missing evidence | Explain conclusion |

Include positive, negative and recovery cases required by the gate. Record absent evidence explicitly. Document exceptions only where the gate permits them; narrowing scope must be reflected in the support claim and requirement mapping.

Record the gate decision, unresolved blockers, remedial work packages, accepted scope and retest triggers. A review cannot promote synthetic evidence to native qualification or authorize an unrelated production change.
